blocks.title: You control access
blocks.content: Notion shows the workspace and permissions before you approve them. You can disconnect the connector in Vetta and manage the connection from Notion.

## Privacy

Vetta connects directly to Notion's hosted MCP endpoint over HTTPS. Authorization credentials stay on this device and are not uploaded to Vetta's servers. Notion data is accessed only when a conversation uses the connector.
